board: AG32VF303CCT6 L48, SRAM-only, control-first, Pico LED-rate oracle GP7, reset GP2
vendor_reference: AG32-Docs tools/vendor_witness/designs_open/clk_rst_high.v / clk_rst_low.v (gen_clock_modes.py, 2026-09-25 clock-mode-matrix session): a 13-bit free-running counter with `always @(posedge clock or posedge reset) if(reset) hb<=0; else hb<=hb+1;` (clk_rst_high, active-high) and the RTL-inverted form (clk_rst_low, `negedge reset_n`), built with af.exe (AGRV2KL48).
decode: agamemnon to-agasc + agamemnon.engine.control_encode.bit_position on both images: both assert the identical bit -- LogicTile (19,12), row 33 (CFG_TILEASYNCMUX, the same row pair `sync` uses for columns 31-33, at columns 27-30 instead), column 29 (CFG_TILEASYNCMUX index 1). Routed netlist: the design's sole alta_asyncctrl instance is at (19,12,z=0), AsyncCtrlMux=2'b10 ('passes Din'); every one of the 13 counter registers shares this signal. Per-slice CFG_ASYNCMUX<z> (W(4z)/column 32) reads 0 for all 13 registers in BOTH images -- the default, unconfigured per-slice selector already selects this line; nothing per-slice is required for this composition.
cross_check: The formula (agamemnon.engine.control_encode.bit_position, tile_bit_base(x,y)+row*928-(column-31)) independently reproduces the 2026-09-03 vendor differential-override sweep at a DIFFERENT tile (memory ag32-config-bit-extractor-replay-2026-09-03): CFG_TILEASYNCMUX measured landing inside bytes 22352 (line1)/22468 (line0) at LogicTile (14,10), exactly the byte range the same formula predicts for columns 27-30 at that tile.
consequence: Establishes the exact physical composition N4.2 (agamemnon/engine/features/shared_control_graph.py, control_encode.py FAMILY_SOURCE_COLUMNS['async_clear'], agrv2k.cc pack_shared_async_clear) admits: LogicTile line 1, CtrlMUX instance 0 ('ctrl_a'), CFG_TILEASYNCMUX index 1, no per-slice bit. ctrl_b (CtrlMUX instance 1), the constant tie, and line 0 have no board evidence and stay refused. One further CFG_TILEASYNCMUX bit (column 27, index 3) differs between the two vendor images without tracking the routing evidence (both route through the same CtrlMUX instance) -- treated as an unclaimed routing artifact of clk_rst_low's one extra RTL-inverter LUT shifting local placement (tools/vendor_parity/CLOCK_MODE_BITS_20260925.md), not part of this admission's claim; clk_rst_high's simpler, board-PASS pattern (without it) is what is claimed.
next_experiment: Open-flow board qualification of the SAME RTL (examples/async-clear-reset/clk_rst_high.v / clk_rst_low.v) built through this admission, plus a multi-tile corpus design (clk_rst_multi_tile.v, 17 registered bits forcing the packer's >16-slice control-set chunk across two physical LogicTiles) -- see this file's next entry once boarded.
